rationale: The only implementation delta is that the fixed version zero-initializes the kernel-side descriptor before copying in its ID, preventing uninitialized fields or padding from being copied back to user space. The Logic section describes entity lookup, descriptor population, user/kernel copying, and error handling, all of which occur in both versions. It does not state that the descriptor is initialized or sanitized before copying it to user space, nor does it otherwise describe the vulnerable uninitialized-data behavior.
